 ## 9. Target Layout & Pattern Algorithms
 
 ### 9.1 Layout (identical shape both OSes; `\` ⇢ `/` on linux)
 
 ```
 <install_root>\<app>\
   releases\<version>\        # immutable payload
   current                    # junction/symlink → releases\<version>
   shared\logs\               # survives releases; app should log here (env LD_SHARED_DIR provided)
   staging\                   # downloads/extract temp; wiped at start & end of every op
   manifest.json
   .lock
 ```
 Creation (win): dirs via `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force`.
 Junction switch (win) — EXACT commands:
 ```powershell
 if (Test-Path '<cur>') { cmd /c rmdir '<cur>' ; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit 42} }
 cmd /c mklink /J '<cur>' '<rel>' ; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit 42}
 ```
 (`rmdir` on a junction removes only the link.) Linux: `ln -sfn '<rel>' '<cur>'`.
 Exit 42 ⇒ ERR_SWITCH.
 Extraction (win): `Expand-Archive -Path pkg.zip -DestinationPath '<rel>' -Force`
 (nupkg renamed to .zip first). Linux: `unzip -o` (preflight: unzip present).
 Every release dir gets `.labdeploy-release.json` = `{version, sha256, extracted_at}`.
 
 Provided env to every pattern (merged under spec `environment`, spec wins):
 `LD_APP, LD_VERSION, LD_RELEASE_DIR, LD_SHARED_DIR, PORT (node only)`.
 
 ### 9.2 windows_service — switchover S-steps (normative)
 
 ```
 S0 CONFIG-PRECHECK: sc.exe query "<svc>" → exit 1060 ⇒ not installed (fresh path)
 S1 (update only) STOP:
      Stop-Service -Name <svc> -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      wait Stopped, poll 1s, max stop_timeout_seconds
 S2 (timeout) FORCE_KILL:
      $pid=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -Filter "Name='<svc>'").ProcessId
      if($pid -gt 0){ taskkill /PID $pid /T /F }
      re-wait 10s; still not Stopped ⇒ exit 43 (ERR_SERVICE_STOP)
 S3 SWITCH junction (§9.1)
 S4 CONFIGURE:
    wrapper=none:
      fresh:  sc.exe create "<svc>" binPath= "\"<cur>\<exe>\" <args>" start= <auto|demand|delayed-auto> DisplayName= "<display>"
              (delayed: start= delayed-auto)   obj= "<account>" password= via env-injected variable when non-builtin
      update: sc.exe config "<svc>" binPath= "..."  (binPath uses CURRENT junction ⇒ normally unchanged)
      sc.exe description "<svc>" "<description>"
      recovery: sc.exe failure "<svc>" reset= 86400 actions= restart/5000/restart/5000/restart/5000
    wrapper=winsw:
      write <cur>\<svc>.winsw.xml:
        <service><id><svc></id><name><display></name><executable><abs exe|node_exe></executable>
        <arguments>…</arguments><logpath><shared>\logs</logpath><stopwait><stop_timeout>sec</stopwait>
        <env name=… value=…/>…</service>
      fresh: & '<cur>\<winsw_exe>' install '<cur>\<svc>.winsw.xml'
      update: & … refresh  (fallback: uninstall+install if refresh exit≠0)
 S5 ENV: Set-ItemProperty HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\<svc>
         -Name Environment -Type MultiString -Value @('K=V',…)   # full merged map §9.1
 S6 START: Start-Service <svc>; poll Get-Service status==Running, 1s, max 60s
         not Running ⇒ capture last 20 System-log 7000/7009/7031/7034 events for <svc> into error detail ⇒ exit 44 (ERR_SERVICE_START)
 S7 HEALTH per §6.5 ⇒ fail exit 45 (ERR_HEALTH_CHECK)
 ```
 Fresh install runs S3(create junction) S4 S5 S6 S7 (no S1/S2).
 
 ### 9.3 console_app
 
 Fresh/update: STAGE → SWITCH → post_install → verify_command (in `<cur>`, with
 env) → health(optional). Nothing persistent runs; Stop/Start are no-ops;
 Status = `n/a` if `.labdeploy-release.json` version matches manifest else drift.
 
 ### 9.4 node_web_app / dotnet_api
 
 node: engine extraction → when install_deps: `npm ci --omit=dev` in release dir
 (BEFORE switch; exit≠0 ⇒ ERR_SERVICE_INSTALL w/ last 50 lines) → then §9.2 with
 wrapper=winsw and executable=node_exe, arguments=`"<cur>\<entry>"`, env includes
 PORT.
 dotnet: §9.2 where binPath = exe (launcher=exe) or
 `"\"<dotnet_exe>\" \"<cur>\<dll>\" <args>"` (launcher=dotnet_dll);
 hosting=winsw uses wrapper path instead. Env includes ASPNETCORE_URLS when set.
 
 ### 9.5 cluster_generic_service — algorithms (normative)
 
 Connectivity: transport connects to EACH host in `target.hosts` (these MUST be
 the cluster node names as `Get-ClusterNode` reports, case-insensitive).
 Cluster cmdlets run on any connected node ("coordinator" = hosts[0]).
 Preflight (coordinator): `Import-Module FailoverClusters` ok;
 `(Get-ClusterNode | ? State -eq 'Up').Name` ⊇ hosts (any spec host not Up ⇒
 ERR_PREFLIGHT); role existence + binding check:
 `Get-ClusterResource | ? {$_.ResourceType -eq 'Generic Service'}` — if role
 `role_name` exists, its `ServiceName` private property MUST equal
 `service_name` else ERR_SERVICE_INSTALL (conflict).
 
 CREATE (role absent):
 ```
 C1 for each node (sequential, hosts order): LOCK, STAGE+EXTRACT release, SWITCH,
    S4 CONFIGURE (sc create, start= demand ← cluster controls start), S5 ENV
 C2 coordinator: Add-ClusterGenericServiceRole -ServiceName <svc> -Name <role>
                 [-StaticAddress <ip>]
    ⇒ error exit 46 ERR_SERVICE_INSTALL
 C3 if preferred_owner: Set-ClusterOwnerNode -Group <role> -Owners <po>,<rest…>
    ; Move-ClusterGroup -Name <role> -Node <po> -Wait <drain>
 C4 Start-ClusterGroup -Name <role> -Wait <drain>  (idempotent if Online)
    state≠Online ⇒ ERR_CLUSTER_MOVE
 C5 sleep health_settle_seconds; HEALTH on OWNER node ⇒ fail: Remove role?
    NO — leave role Offline (Stop-ClusterGroup), report ERR_HEALTH_CHECK,
    manifest.last_operation=failed on all nodes (fresh create has no rollback target)
 C6 FINALIZE manifests all nodes, UNLOCK all
 ```
 
 UPDATE (role exists) — rolling, passive-first (D-order):
 ```
 U0 LOCK all nodes (all-or-nothing; any node ERR_LOCKED ⇒ abort, unlock acquired)
 U1 owner := (Get-ClusterGroup -Name <role>).OwnerNode.Name ; passives := hosts − owner
 U2 for each passive p (hosts order): STAGE+EXTRACT new release on p (NO switch yet)
    — any failure here ⇒ abort; nothing switched; cleanup staging; ERR_*
 U3 for each passive p: SWITCH junction, S4 CONFIGURE(update), S5 ENV
 U4 firstNew := passives[0]
    MOVE_GROUP: Move-ClusterGroup -Name <role> -Node <firstNew> -Wait <drain_timeout>
    verify (Get-ClusterGroup).{OwnerNode==firstNew, State==Online} else exit 47 ERR_CLUSTER_MOVE
 U5 sleep health_settle; HEALTH on firstNew
    ── FAIL ⇒ CLUSTER ROLLBACK:
       R1 Move-ClusterGroup -Node <owner> -Wait <drain>   (old owner still on OLD release)
       R2 verify Online on owner; HEALTH on owner (old version)
       R3 for each passive p: SWITCH junction back to PrevVersion; S4/S5 restore
       R4 manifests: current=old on all; last_operation=rolled_back
       R5 return ERR_HEALTH_CHECK (R1/R2 failure ⇒ ERR_ROLLBACK_FAILED, see §10.6)
 U6 old owner o: STAGE+EXTRACT(already possible in U2? NO — U2 covers passives only;
    stage now), SWITCH, S4, S5   (service on o is stopped — cluster moved away)
 U7 if preferred_owner set and ≠ current owner:
    Move-ClusterGroup -Node <preferred_owner> -Wait <drain>; HEALTH again
 U8 FINALIZE all manifests (current=new, previous=old), PRUNE per node, UNLOCK all
 ```
 Downtime budget: one failover (U4). No step stops the role other than moves.
 
 DESTROY purge: `Stop-ClusterGroup -Name <role>` →
 `Remove-ClusterGroup -Name <role> -RemoveResources -Force` → per node:
 `sc.exe delete <svc>` → remove `<root>\<app>` dir. unregister: role+service
 removed, files kept. abandon: nothing touched.
 
 ### 9.6 docker_container
 
 ```
 D1 (auth) docker login <registry> -u <user> --password-stdin   (value via env/stdin)
 D2 docker pull <image>:<tag>   or  <image>@<digest>
 D3 old := docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' <container_name>  (record for rollback)
 D4 docker rm -f <container_name>   (ignore not-found)
 D5 docker run -d --name <container_name> --restart <policy> [-p …] [-e …] [-v …] <ref>
 D6 HEALTH ⇒ fail & rollback_on_failure ⇒ rm -f; docker run … <old image id>; health; ERR_HEALTH_CHECK
 D7 docker logout (if D1)
 ```

 ## 10. Rollout / Rollback / Read / Destroy Semantics
 
 ### 10.1 Idempotency short-circuit
 If manifest.current_version == spec version AND manifest.artifact_checksum ==
 spec checksum AND pattern Status is healthy-equivalent (`running`/`online`/`n/a`)
 ⇒ Deploy returns success NO-OP (no fetch, no restart). This plus Read makes
 re-apply produce an empty plan (E2E IDP-01).
 
 ### 10.2 Single-target failure & rollback matrix
 
 | Failure at step | Machine mutated? | rollback_on_failure=true action | Result state |
 |---|---|---|---|
 | VALIDATE/CONNECT/PREFLIGHT/LOCK | no | none | old intact |
 | FETCH/CHECKSUM/STAGE/EXTRACT/RENDER | staging only | wipe staging | old intact |
 | SWITCH/CONFIGURE/START/HEALTH (fresh install) | yes | Stop; junction removed; service deleted; manifest absent | machine clean, apply error, no TF state |
 | SWITCH/CONFIGURE/START/HEALTH (update) | yes | Stop → junction→prev → CONFIGURE(prev) → ENV(prev) → Start → HEALTH(prev) | old version RUNNING; TF state unchanged (Update error keeps prior state) ⇒ consistent |
 | any, rollback_on_failure=false | yes | none | manifest.last_operation=failed; Read reports drift (§10.4) |
 
 Rollback itself failing ⇒ §10.6.
 
 ### 10.3 Explicit rollback (pipeline-driven downgrade)
 `terraform apply -var version=<old>` ⇒ Update. Engine treats downgrade
 identically to upgrade EXCEPT: if `releases/<old>` exists AND its
 `.labdeploy-release.json` sha256 matches spec checksum ⇒ SKIP fetch/stage
 (FETCH step logs `cache_hit=true`). Cluster path identical (U-steps).
 
 ### 10.4 Read (refresh)
 Connect (coordinator for cluster) → read manifest.
 - manifest absent ⇒ RemoveResource.
 - else set deployed_version/previous_version/release_path from manifest;
   service_status from pattern.Status (cluster: role State lowercase).
 - manifest.last_operation.result==failed ⇒ append warning diag AND set
   `deployed_version = manifest.current_version + "!failed"` so plan shows a
   change (forces converging apply).
 Read network errors ⇒ Read returns error (refresh fails loudly; no silent drop).
 
 ### 10.5 Destroy modes
 purge: Stop → Uninstall(service/role/container) → remove `<root>/<app>` tree.
 unregister: Stop → Uninstall → keep files+manifest deleted? manifest DELETED
 (else Read after re-create confuses), releases kept.
 abandon: no connection at all; state dropped.
 
 ### 10.6 ERR_ROLLBACK_FAILED
 Both new version failed AND restore failed. Provider MUST: leave `.lock`
 REMOVED, write manifest.last_operation={type:deploy,result:failed}, emit error
 listing both underlying errors, and the diag detail MUST start with
 `MACHINE IN UNKNOWN STATE host=<h>`. Next plan (via §10.4) shows a repairing
 change; apply retries full deploy.
 
 ---
 
 ## 11. Secrets & State Hygiene (MUSTs)
 
 - Specs/state carry env-var NAMES only; provider resolves values at runtime
   from the runner's environment (`os.Getenv`). Missing env var ⇒ ERR_SPEC_INVALID
   `env var <NAME> referenced by <path> is not set`.
 - Secret values MUST never appear in: TF state, plan diffs, tflog at any level,
   error messages, or remote command lines (env-injection only §8.1).
 - `spec` attribute is NOT marked sensitive (it contains no values); computed
   attributes never echo credentials.
 - WinRM insecure_skip_verify=true and ssh host_key="" are permitted (lab) but
   emit a WARN diag once per apply.
 
 ---
 
 ## 12. Error Taxonomy (stable contract for pipelines & tests)
 
 Every diagnostic Summary is exactly `[<CODE>] <short>`; Detail includes
 `host=<h> step=<STEP>` plus remediation hint.
 
 | Code | Meaning | Exit-code marker (remote) |
 |---|---|---|
 | ERR_SPEC_INVALID | schema/substitution/env-name failure | — |
 | ERR_CONNECT | dial/timeout/host-key | — |
 | ERR_AUTH | credential rejected | — |
 | ERR_PREFLIGHT | OS/tool/disk precondition | — |
 | ERR_LOCKED | lock held (§13) | — |
 | ERR_ARTIFACT_FETCH | download/pull failure | — |
 | ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH | sha256 mismatch | 41 |
 | ERR_EXTRACT | expand/unzip failure | — |
 | ERR_SWITCH | junction/symlink | 42 |
 | ERR_SERVICE_STOP | stop+force-kill failed | 43 |
 | ERR_SERVICE_INSTALL | sc create/config, winsw, npm ci, role conflict | 46 |
 | ERR_SERVICE_START | not Running in 60s | 44 |
 | ERR_HEALTH_CHECK | §6.5 budget exhausted | 45 |
 | ERR_CLUSTER_MOVE | Move/Start-ClusterGroup failed/not Online | 47 |
 | ERR_ROLLBACK_FAILED | §10.6 | — |
 | ERR_TIMEOUT | runner.timeout_seconds / TF timeouts | — |
 | ERR_TEST_FAILED | pass_criteria unmet | — |
 | ERR_UNSUPPORTED | pattern×os or feature gap | — |
 
 ## 13. Concurrency & Locking
 
 `.lock` JSON `{owner:"<runner-host>/<pid>", op, started_utc}` created with
 exclusive semantics: win `New-Item -ItemType File` after `Test-Path` guard inside
 one encoded script using `[IO.File]::Open(path,'CreateNew')` (atomic; exists ⇒
 exit 48); linux `set -C; > .lock`. Exists & age < lock_timeout_seconds ⇒
 ERR_LOCKED (fail fast, <5s, no wait). Age ≥ timeout ⇒ overwrite + WARN
 `stale lock from <owner> overridden`. Lock removed in FINALIZE and in ALL error
 paths after LOCK (defer). Cluster: acquire on every node hosts-order,
 release reverse.
 
 ## 14. Pattern × OS Support Matrix (validation table)
 
 | pattern \ os | windows | linux |
 |---|---|---|
 | console_app | ✔ | ✔ |
 | windows_service | ✔ | ✖ ERR_SPEC_INVALID |
 | node_web_app | ✔ | ✖ |
 | dotnet_api | ✔ | ✖ |
 | cluster_generic_service | ✔ | ✖ |
 | docker_container | ✔ (docker preflight) | ✔ |
 
 Artifact×pattern: docker_image only with docker_container (else ERR_SPEC_INVALID);
 zip/nupkg with everything except docker_container (else ERR_SPEC_INVALID).
 
 ## 15. Observability
 
 - tflog structured fields on every step: `app, host, step, version, duration_ms`.
 - `TF_LOG=DEBUG` shows scripts with env values REDACTED (`$env:K='***'`).
 - Deployment resource emits a progress diag WARN only for stale-lock override
   and insecure-transport notices; everything else is log-level.
 
 ## 16. CI/CD Integration (reference, shipped in examples/)
 
 ### 16.1 Provider distribution to runners
 Publish `terraform-provider-labdeploy_v0.1.0_<os>_<arch>.zip` as a release/
 pipeline artifact. Runner install layout (filesystem mirror):
 ```
 $HOME/.terraform.d/plugins/registry.local/smartpcr/labdeploy/0.1.0/linux_amd64/terraform-provider-labdeploy_v0.1.0
 %APPDATA%\terraform.d\plugins\registry.local\smartpcr\labdeploy\0.1.0\windows_amd64\terraform-provider-labdeploy_v0.1.0.exe
 ```
 `~/.terraformrc`:
 ```hcl
 provider_installation {
   filesystem_mirror { path = "/home/runner/.terraform.d/plugins" include = ["registry.local/*/*"] }
   direct { exclude = ["registry.local/*/*"] }
 }
 ```
 TF config: `required_providers { labdeploy = { source = "registry.local/smartpcr/labdeploy", version = "0.1.0" } }`.
 
 ### 16.2 GitHub Actions (examples/pipelines/github-deploy.yml)
 Jobs: `deploy` (init/apply with `-var version=${{ inputs.version }}`,
 env `LABDEPLOY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.LAB_PASSWORD }}`) → e2e is the SAME apply
 (depends_on edge) → `always():` upload `labdeploy-results/**` via
 actions/upload-artifact → `rollback` job `if: failure() && inputs.auto_rollback`
 re-applies `-var version=${{ inputs.rollback_to }}`.
 
 ### 16.3 Azure DevOps (examples/pipelines/azure-pipelines.yml)
 Stages Deploy → (implicit tests in apply) → publish: `PublishTestResults@2`
 (testResultsFormat VSTest, files `**/labdeploy-results/**/*.trx`,
 condition always()) + `PublishPipelineArtifact@1` for logs; Rollback stage
 `condition: failed()` gated by variable, re-apply pinned previous version.
 Secrets via variable group, mapped to env in the step (`env: LABDEPLOY_PASSWORD: $(LabPassword)`).
 
 ## 17. Unit-Test Requirements (per package, go test, no target needed)
 
 | Package | Must cover |
 |---|---|
 | spec | yaml+json parse equivalence; every validation rule in §6/§7 (table-driven, one case per rule id); `${var}` substitution incl. escape & unresolved; canonical hash stability (key order) |
 | transport | encodedCommand exact bytes for known script; chunking math (0, 1, 48000, 48001 bytes); env single-quote escaping (`O'Brien`); local transport round-trip |
 | artifact | sha stream verify; 404; header auth injected; nuget flat-container URL construction |
 | pattern | generated PS for S4 fresh vs update golden-file tests (all 5 patterns); winsw xml golden; cluster scripts golden (create/move/rollback) |
 | engine | state machine unit tests with fake Transport (scripted Result queue): every row of §10.2 matrix; prune keeps previous; lock stale vs fresh; idempotent short-circuit |
 | logs | trx & junit counters parse (fixtures); glob→zip script golden |
 | provider | schema validation (both spec+spec_file, neither); RequiresReplace triggers on each immutable path; state round-trip |
 
 Framework acceptance: `terraform-plugin-testing` acceptance tests behind
 `TF_ACC=1` + env-provided lab targets run the E2E matrix below.

 ## 18. E2E Test Scenario Matrix (normative acceptance)

 ## 19. Implementation Milestones (agent execution order)
 
 1. spec (types/parse/validate) + unit tests → 2. transport (local, ssh, winrm)
 → 3. artifact → 4. engine paths/manifest/lock/health with fake transport tests
 → 5. pattern windows_service + console → 6. deployment resource CRUD → run
 VAL/CON/ART/CAP/WSV → 7. node/dotnet → 8. cluster engine+pattern → CLU → 9.
 e2e_test resource + logs → E2E → 10. docker → 11. examples/pipelines → PIP →
 12. goreleaser packaging.
 
 ## 20. Build & Toolchain Constraints
 
 Go ≥1.22; deps pinned in go.mod: terraform-plugin-framework v1.x,
 terraform-plugin-log, masterzen/winrm, golang.org/x/crypto, pkg/sftp,
 gopkg.in/yaml.v3. `golangci-lint run` clean; `make build test`. Binary name
 `terraform-provider-labdeploy_v<version>`. No cgo. No external runner deps
 beyond terraform itself.
 
 ## 21. Decision Table (ambiguity killers — binding)
 
 | # | Question | Decision |
 |---|---|---|
 | D1 | "provider deployed to target machine"? | Provider always runs on runner; runner==target supported via `transport: local`. |
 | D2 | How are non-SCM exes (node, plain console) run as services? | WinSW; wrapper binary MUST ship inside the artifact (`winsw_exe`). Provider never downloads third-party binaries. |
 | D3 | nupkg semantics | Unzip-in-place; no NuGet client on target. Version/dir name from spec, not nuspec. |
 | D4 | Health check origin | Always executed ON the target (localhost reachable, firewall-independent). |
 | D5 | Cluster binary placement | Local disk per node, identical paths. CSV = v2. |
 | D5b | Cluster + wrapper | Not supported v1; exe must be SCM-aware. |
 | D6 | Secrets | Env-var-name indirection everywhere; values never persisted (§11). |
 | D7 | YAML vs JSON precedence | Both accepted; canonical JSON drives hashing/plan. |
 | D8 | Downgrade | Same code path as upgrade + release cache reuse (§10.3). |
 | D9 | Import | Unsupported v1 (clear error). |
 | D10 | PowerShell baseline | Windows PowerShell 5.1 (no pwsh7 dependency). |
 | D11 | Update failing mid-way, rollback ok | TF state keeps old version; machine restored to old ⇒ consistent by construction. |
 | D12 | Who prunes releases | Engine, after successful FINALIZE only; never deletes `previous_version`. |
 | D13 | E2E on failure leaves no state | Accepted; `triggers` replace-model makes re-runs cheap; reporting mode via `fail_on_test_failure=false`. |
 | D14 | Docker on Windows | Supported when `docker version` preflight passes; otherwise ERR_PREFLIGHT. |
 | D15 | Where do E2E artifacts land in pipelines | Always under `collect.destination_dir`; pipelines publish with always()/condition:always. |

The build gate catches compile failures but NOT silent stale
references (e.g. a test asserting the old name in a string
literal, a YAML config still pointing at the old key). Your
independent re-grep is the only way to catch these.

## Open-questions hard gate
If the engineer surfaced open questions in their
`## Open Questions` JSON block AND the operator hasn't answered
them yet, you MUST score below pass and return verdict `iterate`.
Server-side gate enforces this regardless; your verdict needs to
match so the iteration history reads correctly.

## CONSTRAINT FRESHNESS CHECK BEFORE FLAGGING DRIFT
Before flagging the impl as "drifts from the plan / spec /
requirements", verify the **plan constraint is still consistent
with the workspace's current reality**. The plan is a SNAPSHOT
in time; sibling stages of the same story may have moved the
ground truth past it (new migrations, new ENUM values, new
tables) without the plan being updated. When that happens, the
engineer cannot satisfy both "honor the literal pin" AND "make
real tests pass" — and the right escalation is to stop the
iteration and ask the operator, not to keep iterating against
a broken contract.

Apply this check for every plan-derived constraint you would
cite as a "Still needs improvement" item:

1. **Identify the plan constraint.** Quote it verbatim from
   the plan doc (e.g. *"`implementation-plan.md` Stage 6.4
   step 2 — `applies migrations 0001..0034`"*).
2. **Verify against workspace reality.** Use your read-only
   tools to check the actual state. For migration pins:
   `ls services/*/migrations/ | sort | tail -5` (or the
   repo-appropriate equivalent). For closed sets / ENUM
   assertions: grep the actual ENUM declarations. For
   enumerations ("every `pri_*` knob"): list the actual set
   in code.
3. **If reality EXCEEDS the plan constraint** (e.g. disk has
   migration `0038` but the pin says `0001..0034`; ENUM has
   a value the plan's closed-set doesn't list; the actual
   `pri_*` knob set is larger than the plan enumerates), the
   constraint is **STALE**. DO NOT add the resulting impl
   deviation to "Still needs improvement" as if it were the
   engineer's bug. Instead emit a structured open question
   so the orchestrator routes it to the operator:

   ```json open-questions
   { "openQuestions": [
       {
         "id": "stale-plan-constraint-<short-slug>",
         "text": "Plan constraint `<verbatim pin>` in `<doc>` <section> appears stale: workspace evidence shows <counter-evidence with file path>. Should the plan be updated (operator-approved) to <proposed new value>, OR should the impl narrow its scope to honor the original pin?",
         "type": "choice",
         "choices": ["Update the plan to <proposed value>", "Keep the original pin; narrow the impl"],
         "explanation": "<explain the stale pin, the counter-evidence, and what each option means — define any terms the operator may not know>",
         "choiceAnalysis": [
           { "choice": "Update the plan to <proposed value>", "pros": ["<short pro>"], "cons": ["<short con>"] },
           { "choice": "Keep the original pin; narrow the impl", "pros": ["<short pro>"], "cons": ["<short con>"] }
         ],
         "recommendation": "<the option you recommend, verbatim>",
         "recommendationRationale": "<why, citing the evidence>"
       }
   ] }
   ```

   Your verdict in this iteration MUST be `iterate` (not
   `reject`) and `score` MUST stay ≥ 50 — the engineer is
   correctly blocked on an external decision and shouldn't
   be penalised as if they wrote bad code. Once the operator
   answers, a future iter sees the resolved question and
   proceeds.
4. **If reality MATCHES the plan constraint**, then the impl
   IS drifting from a valid pin — keep the "Still needs
   improvement" item and score normally. The engineer is at
   fault.

This check exists because of the 2026-06-04 pri-postgres
stall: `implementation-plan.md` Stage 6.4 pinned migrations
at `0001..0034`, but sibling stages of the same story had
already added migrations `0035..0038` to the worktree before
this workstream started. The engineer extended the gate to
head (correct against reality) and the evaluator looped for
5+ iterations flagging "contract drift" — which was real
against the literal plan text but unsatisfiable because the
plan text was stale. With this check, the evaluator would
have escalated on iter 1 instead of burning the workstream's
budget.

## Output

Output **only** a fenced JSON block -- no prose outside it. Put
your full technical feedback inside the `notes` field. Structure
the `notes` content in this order:
1. **Improvements this iteration** -- bullet list. Include any
   `[x] FIXED` claims you INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED with your own
   grep.
2. **Still needs improvement** -- emit a markdown CHECKBOX list,
   one item per line, in this exact shape:
     `- [ ] 1. <atomic issue + file:line / function / test ref>`
     `- [ ] 2. <atomic issue + file:line / function / test ref>`
     `- [ ] 3. …`
   Each checkbox starts `unchecked` (`[ ]`). The generator
   echoes these checkboxes into its next-iteration Change
   Summary and flips each to `[x]` with a FIXED / DEFERRED
   note. Keep items atomic -- one issue per checkbox -- so the
   generator can cleanly mark just one of them as fixed
   without ambiguity.

   Include `UNVERIFIED CLAIM` items here whenever your
   re-grep contradicts the generator's claim. Cite the
   specific phrase and line(s) where your grep found hits.

   When scoring iteration N+1, compare the prior iteration's
   checkboxes against the actual code/tests as you see them.
   Items the generator marked `[x] FIXED` but that are STILL
   broken in the code MUST re-appear unchecked in your new
   list with a brief evidence citation so the convergence
   detector can see the regression.

3. **Why this score** -- two sentences max.

Example shape:

```json
{
  "score": 87,
  "dims": { "correctness": 35, "quality": 22, "tests": 13, "scope": 9, "risk": 8 },
  "verdict": "iterate",
  "notes": "Improvements this iteration: ...  Still needs improvement: ...  Why this score: ..."
}
```

Dimension caps (each dim must stay within these bounds -- values
outside the cap are silently clamped, which signals rubric drift
and reduces your authority):
- correctness: 0..40
- quality:     0..25
- tests:       0..15
- scope:       0..10
- risk:        0..10
The five dim caps sum to 100; `score` must equal their sum and
stay in 0..100.

STRICT JSON: double-quoted keys (`"score"`, not `score`), no
trailing commas, no `//` or `/* */` comments. If your JSON is
malformed your entire review is discarded and the iteration is
wasted.

score >= 90 = pass, 70-89 = iterate (be specific in notes),
< 70 = reject.

1. # terraform-provider-labdeploy — Design Specification
2. 
3. Status: v1.0 (implementation spec — normative)
4. Audience: autonomous coding agents. Every "MUST/SHOULD/MAY" is RFC-2119. Anything not
5. specified here is decided by the Decision Table (§21); do not invent behavior.
6. 
7. ---
8. 
9. ## 1. Purpose & Scope
10. 
11. A Terraform provider (Go, terraform-plugin-framework, plugin protocol v6) that a CI
12. pipeline (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) invokes to:
13. 
14. 1. Deploy build artifacts (nupkg / zip / docker image) to target lab machines
15.    (Windows or Linux) over SSH / WinRM / local execution.
16. 2. Manage app lifecycle for five P0 deployment patterns (§9) + one P1 pattern.
17. 3. Run E2E test binaries on the target, evaluate pass criteria, and collect
18.    logs + test results back to the CI runner for publishing.
19. 4. Support rollout (create/upgrade), automatic rollback-on-failure, explicit
20.    rollback (downgrade apply), drift detection, and destroy.
21. 
22. Non-goals (v1): multi-tenant orchestration, Kubernetes, IIS hosting, Linux
23. systemd services (only console/docker patterns on Linux), CSV-hosted cluster
24. binaries, blue/green with load balancers, secret storage (secrets always come
25. from pipeline env vars).
26. 
27. ---
28. 
29. ## 2. Definitions
30. 
31. | Term | Meaning |
32. |---|---|
33. | Runner | Machine executing `terraform` + this provider (GH runner / ADO agent). May equal the target (`transport: local`). |
34. | Target | Lab machine receiving the deployment. Bootstrapped separately with a GH/ADO build agent (out of scope), reachable via SSH/WinRM. |
35. | Spec | YAML or JSON document (kind `Deployment` or `TestRun`) driving one resource. |
36. | Release | Immutable extracted artifact at `<root>/<app>/releases/<version>/`. |
37. | Current | Junction (Windows) / symlink (Linux) `<root>/<app>/current` → active release. |
38. | Manifest | Provider-owned JSON at `<root>/<app>/manifest.json`, source of truth for Read/drift. |
39. | Switchover | The stop → repoint junction → (re)configure service → start sequence. |
40. | Role | WSFC Generic Service cluster group. |
41. 
42. ---
43. 
44. ## 3. System Context
45. 
46. ```
47.  GitHub Actions / ADO pipeline (secrets live here as env vars)
48.         │  terraform init/plan/apply  (-var version=...)
49.         ▼
50.  terraform CLI ──gRPC──► terraform-provider-labdeploy (this binary, runs on runner)
51.         │                        │
52.         │                internal engine
53.         │     ┌───────────┬──────┴──────┬────────────┐
54.         │   spec        transport     artifact     pattern
55.         │  parse/valid  ssh|winrm|    fetch+sha256  console|winsvc|node|
56.         │               local         (or target-   dotnet|cluster|docker
57.         │                             pull)
58.         ▼
59.    Target machine(s): Windows Server 2019/2022 (PS 5.1) or Linux (sh)
60.    Layout: <root>/<app>/{releases/<ver>, current→, shared/, staging/, manifest.json, .lock}
61. ```
62. 
63. The provider binary always runs on the runner. "Deploying the provider to the
64. target" (user requirement) is satisfied by `transport: local` when the pipeline
65. job runs on the target's own build agent (Decision D1).
66. 
67. ---
68. 
69. ## 4. Repository Layout (this repo)
70. 
71. ```
72. terraform-provider-labdeploy/
73. ├── main.go
74. ├── go.mod
75. ├── Makefile
76. ├── docs/DESIGN.md                  ← this file
77. ├── internal/
78. │   ├── provider/                   # TF plugin surface
79. │   │   ├── provider.go
80. │   │   ├── deployment_resource.go
81. │   │   └── e2e_test_resource.go
82. │   ├── spec/                       # types.go, parse.go, validate.go
83. │   ├── transport/                  # transport.go, ssh.go, winrm.go, local.go
84. │   ├── artifact/                   # fetch.go (http|file|nuget|docker ref)
85. │   ├── pattern/                    # pattern.go, windows_service.go, console_app.go,
86. │   │                               # node_dotnet.go, cluster_generic.go, docker_container.go
87. │   ├── engine/                     # engine.go, cluster.go, manifest.go, health.go, paths.go, lock.go
88. │   └── logs/collect.go
89. └── examples/
90.     ├── main.tf
91.     ├── specs/*.yaml                # one per pattern + e2e
92.     └── pipelines/{github-deploy.yml, azure-pipelines.yml}
93. ```
94. 
95. ---
96. 
97. ## 5. Terraform Surface
98. 
99. ### 5.1 Provider block
100. 
101. ```hcl
102. provider "labdeploy" {
103.   # optional; every field can be overridden by spec.target
104.   default_target {
105.     host            = "lab-node-01"
106.     transport       = "winrm"            # ssh | winrm | local
107.     os              = "windows"          # windows | linux
108.     port            = 5986               # 0 => transport default (ssh 22, winrm-https 5986, winrm-http 5985)
109.     username        = "labadmin"
110.     password_env    = "LABDEPLOY_PASSWORD"   # env var NAME on the runner
111.     private_key_env = ""                     # env var NAME holding PEM (ssh only)
112.     winrm_https     = true
113.     winrm_insecure  = true               # skip TLS verify (lab certs)
114.   }
115. }
116. ```
117. 
118. ### 5.2 `labdeploy_deployment`
119. 
120. | Attribute | Type | Req | Notes |
121. |---|---|---|---|
122. | `spec` | string | one-of | Inline YAML/JSON, kind `Deployment`. Exactly one of `spec`/`spec_file` (validated). |
123. | `spec_file` | string | one-of | Path relative to cwd. Content hashed into plan. |
124. | `variables` | map(string) | opt | Substituted into spec: `${var:NAME}` (§6.6). Unknown name ⇒ ERR_SPEC_INVALID. |
125. | `version_override` | string | opt | Overrides `artifact.version` (pipeline passes build number here). |
126. | `destroy_mode` | string | opt | `purge` (default) \| `unregister` \| `abandon` (§10.5). |
127. | **Computed** | | | |
128. | `id` | string | | `sha1(sorted(hosts)+"/"+name)[0:12] + ":" + name` |
129. | `name` | string | | from spec `metadata.name` |
130. | `deployed_version` | string | | after apply / refreshed by Read |
131. | `previous_version` | string | | "" when none |
132. | `hosts` | list(string) | | resolved target hosts |
133. | `release_path` | string | | remote path of current release (owner node for cluster) |
134. | `service_status` | string | | `running` \| `stopped` \| `not_installed` \| `n/a` (console) \| `online` \| `offline` (cluster role) |
135. | `spec_hash` | string | | sha256 of canonical JSON after substitution + override |
136. 
137. Plan semantics:
138. - Change to `spec_hash` ⇒ in-place Update, EXCEPT changes to immutable fields ⇒
139.   **RequiresReplace**: `pattern.type`, `pattern.*.service_name`, `pattern.*.role_name`,
140.   `pattern.install_root`, `metadata.name`, `target.hosts` (set inequality), `target.os`.
141.   Implemented as a plan modifier that parses old+new spec and compares these paths.
142. - `version_override`/`artifact.version` change ⇒ Update (rolling deploy §10.2/§10.3).
143. - Read (refresh) reconciles from target manifest (§10.4). Manifest missing ⇒
144.   `resp.State.RemoveResource` (next plan = create).
145. - Timeouts block supported: create=30m, update=30m, delete=15m defaults.
146. - Import: NOT supported v1 → error `"import is not supported; adopt via apply"`.
147. 
148. ### 5.3 `labdeploy_e2e_test`
149. 
150. | Attribute | Type | Req | Notes |
151. |---|---|---|---|
152. | `spec` / `spec_file` | string | one-of | kind `TestRun`. |
153. | `variables` | map(string) | opt | same substitution. |
154. | `deployment_id` | string | opt | Set to `labdeploy_deployment.x.id` purely to create the dependency edge. |
155. | `triggers` | map(string) | opt | **RequiresReplace**. Pipelines set `{ run = var.build_id }` to force re-run per build. |
156. | `fail_on_test_failure` | bool | opt | default `true`. If true, unmet pass criteria ⇒ apply error ERR_TEST_FAILED (after collection). |
157. | **Computed** | | | |
158. | `passed` | bool | | pass criteria met |
159. | `exit_code` | number | | runner process exit code |
160. | `total_tests` / `passed_tests` / `failed_tests` / `skipped_tests` | number | | from TRX/JUnit; -1 when `results.format: none` |
161. | `results_dir` | string | | LOCAL dir on runner containing downloaded results+logs |
162. | `duration_seconds` | number | | |
163. | `summary` | string | | one-line, e.g. `passed 41/42 (1 failed) in 318s` |
164. 
165. Lifecycle: Create runs the tests. Update is never in-place (all arguments are
166. RequiresReplace). Delete removes the remote test dir (`best effort`, never fails
167. destroy). **Collection always happens before returning a test-failure error** so
168. pipelines can publish artifacts from an `always()` step.
169. 
170. ---
171. 
172. ## 6. Deployment Spec (kind: Deployment) — normative schema
173. 
174. Accepted as YAML or JSON. Provider MUST convert YAML→JSON, apply `${var:*}`
175. substitution, apply `version_override`, then validate. Canonical JSON
176. (sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace) feeds `spec_hash`.
177. 
178. ### 6.1 Envelope
179. 
180. | Path | Type | Req | Default | Validation |
181. |---|---|---|---|---|
182. | `apiVersion` | string | Y | — | == `labdeploy/v1` |
183. | `kind` | string | Y | — | == `Deployment` |
184. | `metadata.name` | string | Y | — | `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$` |
185. | `metadata.labels` | map | N | {} | informational |
186. 
187. ### 6.2 `target`
188. 
189. | Path | Type | Req | Default | Validation |
190. |---|---|---|---|---|
191. | `target.transport` | enum | N* | provider default | `ssh\|winrm\|local` |
192. | `target.hosts` | []string | N* | provider default host | len==1 for all patterns except `cluster_generic_service` (len 2..16). With `local`, MUST be `["localhost"]`. |
193. | `target.os` | enum | Y* | provider default | `windows\|linux`; must satisfy §9 support matrix |
194. | `target.port` | int | N | transport default | 1..65535 |
195. | `target.credentials.username` | string | cond | provider default | required for ssh/winrm |
196. | `target.credentials.password_env` | string | cond | provider default | Name of env var on runner. Secret VALUE never appears in spec/state/logs. |
197. | `target.credentials.private_key_env` | string | cond | — | ssh alt-auth. One of password_env/private_key_env required for ssh. |
198. | `target.winrm.use_https` | bool | N | true | |
199. | `target.winrm.insecure_skip_verify` | bool | N | false | |
200. | `target.winrm.timeout_seconds` | int | N | 60 | per-operation |
201. | `target.ssh.host_key` | string | N | "" | ""=accept-any (lab). Else base64 pubkey pinned. |
202. | `target.ssh.timeout_seconds` | int | N | 30 | dial |
203. | `target.connect_retries` | int | N | 3 | dial retries, 5s backoff |
204. 
205. \* Each field individually falls back to `provider.default_target`; after merge,
206. missing required fields ⇒ ERR_SPEC_INVALID naming the JSON path.
207. 
208. ### 6.3 `artifact`
209. 
210. | Path | Type | Req | Default | Validation |
211. |---|---|---|---|---|
212. | `artifact.type` | enum | Y | — | `zip\|nupkg\|docker_image` |
213. | `artifact.version` | string | Y | — | `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]{0,63}$`; becomes release dir name |
214. | `artifact.checksum` | string | cond | — | `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`. REQUIRED for zip/nupkg. Forbidden for docker_image (use digest). |
215. | `artifact.fetch_mode` | enum | N | `target_pull` when source=http & os supports it, else `runner_push` | `target_pull\|runner_push` (§8.3) |
216. | `artifact.source.type` | enum | Y | — | `http\|file\|nuget_feed\|docker_registry` |
217. | — http: `url` | string | Y | — | https?:// |
218. | — http: `auth.header` | string | N | — | e.g. `Authorization`; value comes from `auth.token_env` |
219. | — http: `auth.token_env` | string | N | — | env var NAME on runner |
220. | — file: `path` | string | Y | — | path on RUNNER |
221. | — nuget_feed: `feed_url`,`package_id` | string | Y | — | version = artifact.version; download URL = `<feed>/flatcontainer/<idLower>/<verLower>/<idLower>.<verLower>.nupkg` (NuGet v3 flat container); `auth.token_env` sent as `Authorization: Bearer` or Basic per `auth.scheme: bearer\|basic(default basic,user=pat)` |
222. | — docker_registry: `image` | string | Y | — | repo without tag |
223. | — docker_registry: `tag` | string | N | =version | |
224. | — docker_registry: `digest` | string | N | — | `sha256:...`; when set, pull by digest and verify |
225. | — docker_registry: `auth.username`,`auth.password_env` | | N | — | `docker login` on target, `docker logout` after |
226. 
227. nupkg handling (D3): treated as zip; extract EVERYTHING preserving paths
228. (`[content_types].xml`, `_rels`, nuspec included — harmless). No nuget.exe on target.
229. 
230. ### 6.4 `pattern` (discriminated union on `pattern.type`)
231. 
232. Common:
233. 
234. | Path | Type | Req | Default |
235. |---|---|---|---|
236. | `pattern.type` | enum | Y | — |
237. | `pattern.install_root` | string | N | `C:\deploy` (win) / `/opt/deploy` (linux) |
238. | `pattern.post_install` | string | N | command run in release dir after extract, before switchover; non-zero exit ⇒ ERR_SERVICE_INSTALL |
239. 
240. `console_app` (os: windows|linux):
241. 
242. | Field | Req | Notes |
243. |---|---|---|
244. | `exe` | Y | path RELATIVE to release dir |
245. | `args` | N | []string |
246. | `verify_command` | N | run in release dir after switchover; exit≠0 ⇒ failure ⇒ rollback |
247. 
248. No service is registered. `service_status` reports `n/a`. "Start" is a no-op;
249. health/verify define success.
250. 
251. `windows_service` (os: windows):
252. 
253. | Field | Req | Default | Notes |
254. |---|---|---|---|
255. | `service_name` | Y | — | `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$` |
256. | `display_name` | N | =service_name | |
257. | `description` | N | "" | |
258. | `exe` | Y | — | relative; the SCM-aware binary when wrapper=none |
259. | `args` | N | [] | |
260. | `wrapper` | N | `none` | `none\|winsw`. `none` ⇒ exe MUST implement SCM (e.g. .NET `UseWindowsService()`). |
261. | `winsw_exe` | cond | — | REQUIRED iff wrapper=winsw; relative path of WinSW binary INSIDE the artifact (D2). |
262. | `start_type` | N | `auto` | `auto\|manual\|delayed` |
263. | `account.username` | N | `LocalSystem` | or `NT AUTHORITY\NetworkService`, `.\user` |
264. | `account.password_env` | cond | — | required for non-builtin accounts |
265. | `recovery.restart_on_failure` | N | true | maps to `sc.exe failure ... actions= restart/5000/restart/5000/restart/5000 reset= 86400` |

269. 
270. | Field | Req | Default | Notes |
271. |---|---|---|---|
272. | `service_name` | Y | — | |
273. | `entry` | Y | — | e.g. `server.js`, relative |
274. | `node_exe` | N | `node` | must resolve on target PATH (preflight check `node --version`) |
275. | `port` | Y | — | exported as env `PORT` |
276. | `install_deps` | N | false | true ⇒ run `npm ci --omit=dev` in release dir (preflight `npm --version`); requires `package-lock.json` in artifact else ERR_SERVICE_INSTALL |
277. | `winsw_exe` | Y | — | relative path inside artifact |
278. | `stop_timeout_seconds` | N | 30 | |
279. 
280. `dotnet_api` (os: windows):
281. 
282. | Field | Req | Default | Notes |
283. |---|---|---|---|
284. | `service_name` | Y | — | |
285. | `launcher` | N | `exe` | `exe\|dotnet_dll` |
286. | `exe` | cond | — | required when launcher=exe (self-contained or apphost) |
287. | `dll` | cond | — | required when launcher=dotnet_dll; binPath becomes `"<dotnet_exe>" "<release>\<dll>" <args>`; preflight `dotnet --list-runtimes` must contain `Microsoft.AspNetCore.App` |
288. | `dotnet_exe` | N | `dotnet` | |
289. | `urls` | N | — | exported as `ASPNETCORE_URLS` |
290. | `hosting` | N | `windows_service_native` | `windows_service_native` (app uses UseWindowsService) \| `winsw` (+`winsw_exe`) |
291. | `args`,`account`,`recovery`,`stop_timeout_seconds` | | | same as windows_service |
292. 
293. `cluster_generic_service` (os: windows, hosts=all cluster node names, 2..16):
294. 
295. | Field | Req | Default | Notes |
296. |---|---|---|---|
297. | `service_name` | Y | — | Windows service registered on EVERY node, identical binPath |
298. | `role_name` | Y | — | cluster group name |
299. | `exe`,`args` | Y/N | | as windows_service; wrapper NOT supported (SCM-aware exe required, D5b) |
300. | `static_address` | N | — | passed to `Add-ClusterGenericServiceRole -StaticAddress` (creates CAP) |
301. | `preferred_owner` | N | — | if set, `Set-ClusterOwnerNode` after create; role moved here at end of successful update |
302. | `account`,`recovery`,`stop_timeout_seconds` | | | as windows_service |
303. 
304. Binaries live on EACH node's local disk at identical `install_root` paths (D5).
305. CSV-hosted binaries: out of scope v1.
306. 
307. `docker_container` (os: linux or windows w/ docker; P1):
308. 
309. | Field | Req | Default |
310. |---|---|---|
311. | `container_name` | Y | — |
312. | `ports` | N | [] `"host:container"` |
313. | `env_passthrough` | N | uses `environment` map below |

395. ## 8. Component Contracts
396. 
397. ### 8.1 transport
398. 
399. ```go
400. type Shell int // ShellPowerShell, ShellSh, ShellCmd
401. type Cmd struct{ Shell Shell; Script string; TimeoutSec int; Env map[string]string }
402. type Result struct{ ExitCode int; Stdout, Stderr string }
403. 
404. type Transport interface {
405.     Connect(ctx context.Context) error
406.     Close() error
407.     OS() spec.OSKind
408.     Host() string
409.     Exec(ctx context.Context, c Cmd) (Result, error) // err = transport failure ONLY; app exit codes go in Result
410.     Upload(ctx context.Context, local io.Reader, size int64, remote string) error
411.     Download(ctx context.Context, remote, local string) error
412. }
413. ```
414. 
415. Rules:
416. - Windows targets: ALL scripts are PowerShell 5.1 (`ShellPowerShell`), executed
417.   as `powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass
418.   -EncodedCommand <base64(UTF-16LE(script))>` — identical over WinRM and SSH
419.   (works from cmd default shell). `Env` is injected by prepending
420.   `$env:K='V';` lines (single-quote escaped) — never on the command line in
421.   clear (values may be secrets).
422. - Linux targets: `ShellSh` ⇒ `sh -c '<script>'` with env prepended `K='V' `.
423. - WinRM upload: chunked base64 append. Chunk = 48,000 raw bytes. First chunk:
424.   `[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p,[Convert]::FromBase64String($b))`; subsequent:
425.   open FileStream Append + Write. Progress logged every 5 MB at TRACE.
426. - SSH upload/download: SFTP subsystem (`github.com/pkg/sftp`).
427. - Local: `os/exec` + file copy; `Connect` verifies OS matches `target.os`.
428. - `Connect` retries `target.connect_retries` times, 5s fixed backoff.
429.   Auth rejection (winrm 401, ssh auth error) is NOT retried ⇒ ERR_AUTH.
430.   Dial/timeout ⇒ ERR_CONNECT.
431. - Preflight (engine, after connect): win ⇒ `$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major`
432.   must be ≥5; free disk on install_root drive ≥ 2× artifact size (skip when
433.   size unknown); pattern-specific tool checks (node/npm/dotnet/docker/
434.   FailoverClusters module) per §6.4 ⇒ failures are ERR_PREFLIGHT.
435. 
436. ### 8.2 artifact
437. 
438. ```go
439. type Fetched struct{ LocalPath string; Sha256 string; Size int64 } // runner temp file
440. Fetch(ctx, s spec.Artifact, vars Secrets) (Fetched, error)          // http|file|nuget → temp zip
441. TargetPullScript(s spec.Artifact) (script string, ok bool)          // §8.3
442. ```
443. - http/nuget: stream to `os.CreateTemp`, compute sha256 while streaming; compare
444.   to `artifact.checksum` ⇒ mismatch = ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH (temp deleted).
445.   4xx/5xx/conn error ⇒ ERR_ARTIFACT_FETCH (include status + first 256B body).
446. - docker_image: no fetch on runner; returns ref string; pull happens on target
447.   inside pattern (§9.6) — bad creds/pull failure ⇒ ERR_ARTIFACT_FETCH.
448. 
449. ### 8.3 target_pull (default for http/nuget sources)
450. 
451. Runner never proxies large payloads. Generated PS (win):
452. ```powershell
453. $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'
454. $h=@{}; if($env:LD_AUTH_VALUE){$h['<auth.header|Authorization>']=$env:LD_AUTH_VALUE}
455. Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri '<url>' -Headers $h -OutFile '<staging>\pkg.zip'
456. $sha=(Get-FileHash '<staging>\pkg.zip' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
457. if($sha -ne '<hex>'){ Write-Error "checksum mismatch: $sha"; exit 41 }
458. ```
459. `LD_AUTH_VALUE` is passed via Cmd.Env (encoded script, not persisted). Exit 41
460. maps to ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH. Linux analog uses curl + `sha256sum`.
461. `fetch_mode: runner_push` forces §8.2 + Upload (used when target has no
462. egress). file:// sources always runner_push.
463. 
464. ### 8.4 pattern
465. 
466. ```go
467. type ReleaseCtx struct{ App, Version string; P Paths; Spec *spec.Deployment; PrevVersion string }
468. type Pattern interface {
469.     Validate(s *spec.Deployment) error                       // static, pattern-specific
470.     Preflight(ctx, t Transport, rc ReleaseCtx) error
471.     Configure(ctx, t Transport, rc ReleaseCtx) error         // idempotent: create/update service reg, env, wrapper cfg. Files already switched.
472.     Stop(ctx, t, rc) error                                   // no-op if absent/stopped
473.     Start(ctx, t, rc) error                                  // wait until Running/exit ok
474.     Status(ctx, t, rc) (string, error)                       // §5.2 service_status values
475.     Uninstall(ctx, t, rc, purge bool) error
476. }
477. ```
478. Engine owns: fetch, staging, extraction, junction switch, files/env rendering,
479. health, manifest, prune, lock. Patterns own service/SCM/docker/cluster verbs.
480. 
481. ### 8.5 engine
482. 
483. `Deploy(ctx, s) (*Status, error)`, `Destroy(ctx, s, mode)`, `ReadStatus(ctx, s)`.
484. Cluster spec routes to `engine/cluster.go`. All remote steps logged via tflog
485. (`step=<NAME> host=<h>`), names exactly: VALIDATE CONNECT PREFLIGHT LOCK FETCH
486. CHECKSUM STAGE EXTRACT RENDER CONFIGURE STOP SWITCH START HEALTH FINALIZE PRUNE
487. UNLOCK ROLLBACK FORCE_KILL MOVE_GROUP.

491. ## 9. Target Layout & Pattern Algorithms
492. 
493. ### 9.1 Layout (identical shape both OSes; `\` ⇢ `/` on linux)
494. 
495. ```
496. <install_root>\<app>\
497.   releases\<version>\        # immutable payload
498.   current                    # junction/symlink → releases\<version>
499.   shared\logs\               # survives releases; app should log here (env LD_SHARED_DIR provided)
500.   staging\                   # downloads/extract temp; wiped at start & end of every op
501.   manifest.json
502.   .lock
503. ```
504. Creation (win): dirs via `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force`.
505. Junction switch (win) — EXACT commands:
506. ```powershell
507. if (Test-Path '<cur>') { cmd /c rmdir '<cur>' ; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit 42} }
508. cmd /c mklink /J '<cur>' '<rel>' ; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit 42}
509. ```
510. (`rmdir` on a junction removes only the link.) Linux: `ln -sfn '<rel>' '<cur>'`.
511. Exit 42 ⇒ ERR_SWITCH.
512. Extraction (win): `Expand-Archive -Path pkg.zip -DestinationPath '<rel>' -Force`
513. (nupkg renamed to .zip first). Linux: `unzip -o` (preflight: unzip present).
514. Every release dir gets `.labdeploy-release.json` = `{version, sha256, extracted_at}`.
515. 
516. Provided env to every pattern (merged under spec `environment`, spec wins):
517. `LD_APP, LD_VERSION, LD_RELEASE_DIR, LD_SHARED_DIR, PORT (node only)`.
518. 
519. ### 9.2 windows_service — switchover S-steps (normative)
520. 
521. ```
522. S0 CONFIG-PRECHECK: sc.exe query "<svc>" → exit 1060 ⇒ not installed (fresh path)
523. S1 (update only) STOP:
524.      Stop-Service -Name <svc> -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
525.      wait Stopped, poll 1s, max stop_timeout_seconds
526. S2 (timeout) FORCE_KILL:
527.      $pid=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -Filter "Name='<svc>'").ProcessId
528.      if($pid -gt 0){ taskkill /PID $pid /T /F }
529.      re-wait 10s; still not Stopped ⇒ exit 43 (ERR_SERVICE_STOP)
530. S3 SWITCH junction (§9.1)
531. S4 CONFIGURE:
532.    wrapper=none:
533.      fresh:  sc.exe create "<svc>" binPath= "\"<cur>\<exe>\" <args>" start= <auto|demand|delayed-auto> DisplayName= "<display>"
534.              (delayed: start= delayed-auto)   obj= "<account>" password= via env-injected variable when non-builtin
535.      update: sc.exe config "<svc>" binPath= "..."  (binPath uses CURRENT junction ⇒ normally unchanged)
536.      sc.exe description "<svc>" "<description>"
537.      recovery: sc.exe failure "<svc>" reset= 86400 actions= restart/5000/restart/5000/restart/5000
538.    wrapper=winsw:
539.      write <cur>\<svc>.winsw.xml:
540.        <service><id><svc></id><name><display></name><executable><abs exe|node_exe></executable>
541.        <arguments>…</arguments><logpath><shared>\logs</logpath><stopwait><stop_timeout>sec</stopwait>
542.        <env name=… value=…/>…</service>
543.      fresh: & '<cur>\<winsw_exe>' install '<cur>\<svc>.winsw.xml'
544.      update: & … refresh  (fallback: uninstall+install if refresh exit≠0)
545. S5 ENV: Set-ItemProperty HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\<svc>
546.         -Name Environment -Type MultiString -Value @('K=V',…)   # full merged map §9.1
547. S6 START: Start-Service <svc>; poll Get-Service status==Running, 1s, max 60s
548.         not Running ⇒ capture last 20 System-log 7000/7009/7031/7034 events for <svc> into error detail ⇒ exit 44 (ERR_SERVICE_START)
549. S7 HEALTH per §6.5 ⇒ fail exit 45 (ERR_HEALTH_CHECK)
550. ```
551. Fresh install runs S3(create junction) S4 S5 S6 S7 (no S1/S2).
552. 
553. ### 9.3 console_app
554. 
555. Fresh/update: STAGE → SWITCH → post_install → verify_command (in `<cur>`, with
556. env) → health(optional). Nothing persistent runs; Stop/Start are no-ops;
557. Status = `n/a` if `.labdeploy-release.json` version matches manifest else drift.
558. 
559. ### 9.4 node_web_app / dotnet_api
560. 
561. node: engine extraction → when install_deps: `npm ci --omit=dev` in release dir
562. (BEFORE switch; exit≠0 ⇒ ERR_SERVICE_INSTALL w/ last 50 lines) → then §9.2 with
563. wrapper=winsw and executable=node_exe, arguments=`"<cur>\<entry>"`, env includes
564. PORT.
565. dotnet: §9.2 where binPath = exe (launcher=exe) or
566. `"\"<dotnet_exe>\" \"<cur>\<dll>\" <args>"` (launcher=dotnet_dll);
567. hosting=winsw uses wrapper path instead. Env includes ASPNETCORE_URLS when set.

569. ### 9.5 cluster_generic_service — algorithms (normative)
570. 
571. Connectivity: transport connects to EACH host in `target.hosts` (these MUST be
572. the cluster node names as `Get-ClusterNode` reports, case-insensitive).
573. Cluster cmdlets run on any connected node ("coordinator" = hosts[0]).
574. Preflight (coordinator): `Import-Module FailoverClusters` ok;
575. `(Get-ClusterNode | ? State -eq 'Up').Name` ⊇ hosts (any spec host not Up ⇒
576. ERR_PREFLIGHT); role existence + binding check:
577. `Get-ClusterResource | ? {$_.ResourceType -eq 'Generic Service'}` — if role
578. `role_name` exists, its `ServiceName` private property MUST equal
579. `service_name` else ERR_SERVICE_INSTALL (conflict).
580. 
581. CREATE (role absent):
582. ```
583. C1 for each node (sequential, hosts order): LOCK, STAGE+EXTRACT release, SWITCH,
584.    S4 CONFIGURE (sc create, start= demand ← cluster controls start), S5 ENV
585. C2 coordinator: Add-ClusterGenericServiceRole -ServiceName <svc> -Name <role>
586.                 [-StaticAddress <ip>]
587.    ⇒ error exit 46 ERR_SERVICE_INSTALL
588. C3 if preferred_owner: Set-ClusterOwnerNode -Group <role> -Owners <po>,<rest…>
589.    ; Move-ClusterGroup -Name <role> -Node <po> -Wait <drain>
590. C4 Start-ClusterGroup -Name <role> -Wait <drain>  (idempotent if Online)
591.    state≠Online ⇒ ERR_CLUSTER_MOVE
592. C5 sleep health_settle_seconds; HEALTH on OWNER node ⇒ fail: Remove role?
593.    NO — leave role Offline (Stop-ClusterGroup), report ERR_HEALTH_CHECK,
594.    manifest.last_operation=failed on all nodes (fresh create has no rollback target)
595. C6 FINALIZE manifests all nodes, UNLOCK all
596. ```
597. 
598. UPDATE (role exists) — rolling, passive-first (D-order):
599. ```
600. U0 LOCK all nodes (all-or-nothing; any node ERR_LOCKED ⇒ abort, unlock acquired)
601. U1 owner := (Get-ClusterGroup -Name <role>).OwnerNode.Name ; passives := hosts − owner
602. U2 for each passive p (hosts order): STAGE+EXTRACT new release on p (NO switch yet)
603.    — any failure here ⇒ abort; nothing switched; cleanup staging; ERR_*
604. U3 for each passive p: SWITCH junction, S4 CONFIGURE(update), S5 ENV
605. U4 firstNew := passives[0]
606.    MOVE_GROUP: Move-ClusterGroup -Name <role> -Node <firstNew> -Wait <drain_timeout>
607.    verify (Get-ClusterGroup).{OwnerNode==firstNew, State==Online} else exit 47 ERR_CLUSTER_MOVE
608. U5 sleep health_settle; HEALTH on firstNew
609.    ── FAIL ⇒ CLUSTER ROLLBACK:
610.       R1 Move-ClusterGroup -Node <owner> -Wait <drain>   (old owner still on OLD release)
611.       R2 verify Online on owner; HEALTH on owner (old version)
612.       R3 for each passive p: SWITCH junction back to PrevVersion; S4/S5 restore
613.       R4 manifests: current=old on all; last_operation=rolled_back
614.       R5 return ERR_HEALTH_CHECK (R1/R2 failure ⇒ ERR_ROLLBACK_FAILED, see §10.6)
615. U6 old owner o: STAGE+EXTRACT(already possible in U2? NO — U2 covers passives only;
616.    stage now), SWITCH, S4, S5   (service on o is stopped — cluster moved away)
617. U7 if preferred_owner set and ≠ current owner:
618.    Move-ClusterGroup -Node <preferred_owner> -Wait <drain>; HEALTH again
619. U8 FINALIZE all manifests (current=new, previous=old), PRUNE per node, UNLOCK all
620. ```
621. Downtime budget: one failover (U4). No step stops the role other than moves.
622. 
623. DESTROY purge: `Stop-ClusterGroup -Name <role>` →
624. `Remove-ClusterGroup -Name <role> -RemoveResources -Force` → per node:
625. `sc.exe delete <svc>` → remove `<root>\<app>` dir. unregister: role+service
626. removed, files kept. abandon: nothing touched.
627. 
628. ### 9.6 docker_container
629. 
630. ```
631. D1 (auth) docker login <registry> -u <user> --password-stdin   (value via env/stdin)
632. D2 docker pull <image>:<tag>   or  <image>@<digest>
633. D3 old := docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' <container_name>  (record for rollback)
634. D4 docker rm -f <container_name>   (ignore not-found)
635. D5 docker run -d --name <container_name> --restart <policy> [-p …] [-e …] [-v …] <ref>
636. D6 HEALTH ⇒ fail & rollback_on_failure ⇒ rm -f; docker run … <old image id>; health; ERR_HEALTH_CHECK
637. D7 docker logout (if D1)
638. ```
639. manifest.current_version = spec version; image id recorded in manifest.extra.

643. ## 10. Rollout / Rollback / Read / Destroy Semantics
644. 
645. ### 10.1 Idempotency short-circuit
646. If manifest.current_version == spec version AND manifest.artifact_checksum ==
647. spec checksum AND pattern Status is healthy-equivalent (`running`/`online`/`n/a`)
648. ⇒ Deploy returns success NO-OP (no fetch, no restart). This plus Read makes
649. re-apply produce an empty plan (E2E IDP-01).
650. 
651. ### 10.2 Single-target failure & rollback matrix
652. 
653. | Failure at step | Machine mutated? | rollback_on_failure=true action | Result state |
654. |---|---|---|---|
655. | VALIDATE/CONNECT/PREFLIGHT/LOCK | no | none | old intact |
656. | FETCH/CHECKSUM/STAGE/EXTRACT/RENDER | staging only | wipe staging | old intact |
657. | SWITCH/CONFIGURE/START/HEALTH (fresh install) | yes | Stop; junction removed; service deleted; manifest absent | machine clean, apply error, no TF state |
658. | SWITCH/CONFIGURE/START/HEALTH (update) | yes | Stop → junction→prev → CONFIGURE(prev) → ENV(prev) → Start → HEALTH(prev) | old version RUNNING; TF state unchanged (Update error keeps prior state) ⇒ consistent |
659. | any, rollback_on_failure=false | yes | none | manifest.last_operation=failed; Read reports drift (§10.4) |
660. 
661. Rollback itself failing ⇒ §10.6.
662. 
663. ### 10.3 Explicit rollback (pipeline-driven downgrade)
664. `terraform apply -var version=<old>` ⇒ Update. Engine treats downgrade
665. identically to upgrade EXCEPT: if `releases/<old>` exists AND its
666. `.labdeploy-release.json` sha256 matches spec checksum ⇒ SKIP fetch/stage
667. (FETCH step logs `cache_hit=true`). Cluster path identical (U-steps).
668. 
669. ### 10.4 Read (refresh)
670. Connect (coordinator for cluster) → read manifest.
671. - manifest absent ⇒ RemoveResource.
672. - else set deployed_version/previous_version/release_path from manifest;
673.   service_status from pattern.Status (cluster: role State lowercase).
674. - manifest.last_operation.result==failed ⇒ append warning diag AND set
675.   `deployed_version = manifest.current_version + "!failed"` so plan shows a
676.   change (forces converging apply).
677. Read network errors ⇒ Read returns error (refresh fails loudly; no silent drop).
678. 
679. ### 10.5 Destroy modes
680. purge: Stop → Uninstall(service/role/container) → remove `<root>/<app>` tree.
681. unregister: Stop → Uninstall → keep files+manifest deleted? manifest DELETED
682. (else Read after re-create confuses), releases kept.
683. abandon: no connection at all; state dropped.
684. 
685. ### 10.6 ERR_ROLLBACK_FAILED
686. Both new version failed AND restore failed. Provider MUST: leave `.lock`
687. REMOVED, write manifest.last_operation={type:deploy,result:failed}, emit error
688. listing both underlying errors, and the diag detail MUST start with
689. `MACHINE IN UNKNOWN STATE host=<h>`. Next plan (via §10.4) shows a repairing
690. change; apply retries full deploy.
691.

694. ## 11. Secrets & State Hygiene (MUSTs)
695. 
696. - Specs/state carry env-var NAMES only; provider resolves values at runtime
697.   from the runner's environment (`os.Getenv`). Missing env var ⇒ ERR_SPEC_INVALID
698.   `env var <NAME> referenced by <path> is not set`.
699. - Secret values MUST never appear in: TF state, plan diffs, tflog at any level,
700.   error messages, or remote command lines (env-injection only §8.1).
701. - `spec` attribute is NOT marked sensitive (it contains no values); computed
702.   attributes never echo credentials.
703. - WinRM insecure_skip_verify=true and ssh host_key="" are permitted (lab) but
704.   emit a WARN diag once per apply.
705.

708. ## 12. Error Taxonomy (stable contract for pipelines & tests)
709. 
710. Every diagnostic Summary is exactly `[<CODE>] <short>`; Detail includes
711. `host=<h> step=<STEP>` plus remediation hint.
712. 
713. | Code | Meaning | Exit-code marker (remote) |
714. |---|---|---|
715. | ERR_SPEC_INVALID | schema/substitution/env-name failure | — |
716. | ERR_CONNECT | dial/timeout/host-key | — |
717. | ERR_AUTH | credential rejected | — |
718. | ERR_PREFLIGHT | OS/tool/disk precondition | — |

734. ## 13. Concurrency & Locking
735. 
736. `.lock` JSON `{owner:"<runner-host>/<pid>", op, started_utc}` created with
737. exclusive semantics: win `New-Item -ItemType File` after `Test-Path` guard inside
738. one encoded script using `[IO.File]::Open(path,'CreateNew')` (atomic; exists ⇒
739. exit 48); linux `set -C; > .lock`. Exists & age < lock_timeout_seconds ⇒
740. ERR_LOCKED (fail fast, <5s, no wait). Age ≥ timeout ⇒ overwrite + WARN
741. `stale lock from <owner> overridden`. Lock removed in FINALIZE and in ALL error
742. paths after LOCK (defer). Cluster: acquire on every node hosts-order,
743. release reverse.

972. | # | Question | Decision |
973. |---|---|---|
974. | D1 | "provider deployed to target machine"? | Provider always runs on runner; runner==target supported via `transport: local`. |

977. | D4 | Health check origin | Always executed ON the target (localhost reachable, firewall-independent). |
978. | D5 | Cluster binary placement | Local disk per node, identical paths. CSV = v2. |
979. | D5b | Cluster + wrapper | Not supported v1; exe must be SCM-aware. |
980. | D6 | Secrets | Env-var-name indirection everywhere; values never persisted (§11). |
981. | D7 | YAML vs JSON precedence | Both accepted; canonical JSON drives hashing/plan. |
982. | D8 | Downgrade | Same code path as upgrade + release cache reuse (§10.3). |
983. | D9 | Import | Unsupported v1 (clear error). |
984. | D10 | PowerShell baseline | Windows PowerShell 5.1 (no pwsh7 dependency). |
985. | D11 | Update failing mid-way, rollback ok | TF state keeps old version; machine restored to old ⇒ consistent by construction. |
986. | D12 | Who prunes releases | Engine, after successful FINALIZE only; never deletes `previous_version`. |
987. | D13 | E2E on failure leaves no state | Accepted; `triggers` replace-model makes re-runs cheap; reporting mode via `fail_on_test_failure=false`. |
988. | D14 | Docker on Windows | Supported when `docker version` preflight passes; otherwise ERR_PREFLIGHT. |

 # terraform-provider-labdeploy — Design Specification
 
 Status: v1.0 (implementation spec — normative)
 Audience: autonomous coding agents. Every "MUST/SHOULD/MAY" is RFC-2119. Anything not
 specified here is decided by the Decision Table (§21); do not invent behavior.
 
 ---
 
 ## 1. Purpose & Scope
 
 A Terraform provider (Go, terraform-plugin-framework, plugin protocol v6) that a CI
 pipeline (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) invokes to:
 
 1. Deploy build artifacts (nupkg / zip / docker image) to target lab machines
    (Windows or Linux) over SSH / WinRM / local execution.
 2. Manage app lifecycle for five P0 deployment patterns (§9) + one P1 pattern.
 3. Run E2E test binaries on the target, evaluate pass criteria, and collect
    logs + test results back to the CI runner for publishing.
 4. Support rollout (create/upgrade), automatic rollback-on-failure, explicit
    rollback (downgrade apply), drift detection, and destroy.
 
 Non-goals (v1): multi-tenant orchestration, Kubernetes, IIS hosting, Linux
 systemd services (only console/docker patterns on Linux), CSV-hosted cluster
 binaries, blue/green with load balancers, secret storage (secrets always come
 from pipeline env vars).
 
 ---
 
 ## 2. Definitions
 
 | Term | Meaning |
 |---|---|
 | Runner | Machine executing `terraform` + this provider (GH runner / ADO agent). May equal the target (`transport: local`). |
 | Target | Lab machine receiving the deployment. Bootstrapped separately with a GH/ADO build agent (out of scope), reachable via SSH/WinRM. |
 | Spec | YAML or JSON document (kind `Deployment` or `TestRun`) driving one resource. |
 | Release | Immutable extracted artifact at `<root>/<app>/releases/<version>/`. |
 | Current | Junction (Windows) / symlink (Linux) `<root>/<app>/current` → active release. |
 | Manifest | Provider-owned JSON at `<root>/<app>/manifest.json`, source of truth for Read/drift. |
 | Switchover | The stop → repoint junction → (re)configure service → start sequence. |
 | Role | WSFC Generic Service cluster group. |
 
 ---
 
 ## 3. System Context
 
 ```
  GitHub Actions / ADO pipeline (secrets live here as env vars)
         │  terraform init/plan/apply  (-var version=...)
         ▼
  terraform CLI ──gRPC──► terraform-provider-labdeploy (this binary, runs on runner)
         │                        │
         │                internal engine
         │     ┌───────────┬──────┴──────┬────────────┐
         │   spec        transport     artifact     pattern
         │  parse/valid  ssh|winrm|    fetch+sha256  console|winsvc|node|
         │               local         (or target-   dotnet|cluster|docker
         │                             pull)
         ▼
    Target machine(s): Windows Server 2019/2022 (PS 5.1) or Linux (sh)
    Layout: <root>/<app>/{releases/<ver>, current→, shared/, staging/, manifest.json, .lock}
 ```
 
 The provider binary always runs on the runner. "Deploying the provider to the
 target" (user requirement) is satisfied by `transport: local` when the pipeline
 job runs on the target's own build agent (Decision D1).

 ## 5. Terraform Surface
 
 ### 5.1 Provider block
 
 ```hcl
 provider "labdeploy" {
   # optional; every field can be overridden by spec.target
   default_target {
     host            = "lab-node-01"
     transport       = "winrm"            # ssh | winrm | local
     os              = "windows"          # windows | linux
     port            = 5986               # 0 => transport default (ssh 22, winrm-https 5986, winrm-http 5985)
     username        = "labadmin"
     password_env    = "LABDEPLOY_PASSWORD"   # env var NAME on the runner
     private_key_env = ""                     # env var NAME holding PEM (ssh only)
     winrm_https     = true
     winrm_insecure  = true               # skip TLS verify (lab certs)
   }
 }
 ```
 
 ### 5.2 `labdeploy_deployment`
 
 | Attribute | Type | Req | Notes |
 |---|---|---|---|
 | `spec` | string | one-of | Inline YAML/JSON, kind `Deployment`. Exactly one of `spec`/`spec_file` (validated). |
 | `spec_file` | string | one-of | Path relative to cwd. Content hashed into plan. |
 | `variables` | map(string) | opt | Substituted into spec: `${var:NAME}` (§6.6). Unknown name ⇒ ERR_SPEC_INVALID. |
 | `version_override` | string | opt | Overrides `artifact.version` (pipeline passes build number here). |
 | `destroy_mode` | string | opt | `purge` (default) \| `unregister` \| `abandon` (§10.5). |
 | **Computed** | | | |
 | `id` | string | | `sha1(sorted(hosts)+"/"+name)[0:12] + ":" + name` |
 | `name` | string | | from spec `metadata.name` |
 | `deployed_version` | string | | after apply / refreshed by Read |
 | `previous_version` | string | | "" when none |
 | `hosts` | list(string) | | resolved target hosts |
 | `release_path` | string | | remote path of current release (owner node for cluster) |
 | `service_status` | string | | `running` \| `stopped` \| `not_installed` \| `n/a` (console) \| `online` \| `offline` (cluster role) |
 | `spec_hash` | string | | sha256 of canonical JSON after substitution + override |
 
 Plan semantics:
 - Change to `spec_hash` ⇒ in-place Update, EXCEPT changes to immutable fields ⇒
   **RequiresReplace**: `pattern.type`, `pattern.*.service_name`, `pattern.*.role_name`,
   `pattern.install_root`, `metadata.name`, `target.hosts` (set inequality), `target.os`.
   Implemented as a plan modifier that parses old+new spec and compares these paths.
 - `version_override`/`artifact.version` change ⇒ Update (rolling deploy §10.2/§10.3).
 - Read (refresh) reconciles from target manifest (§10.4). Manifest missing ⇒
   `resp.State.RemoveResource` (next plan = create).
 - Timeouts block supported: create=30m, update=30m, delete=15m defaults.
 - Import: NOT supported v1 → error `"import is not supported; adopt via apply"`.
 
 ### 5.3 `labdeploy_e2e_test`
 
 | Attribute | Type | Req | Notes |
 |---|---|---|---|
 | `spec` / `spec_file` | string | one-of | kind `TestRun`. |
 | `variables` | map(string) | opt | same substitution. |
 | `deployment_id` | string | opt | Set to `labdeploy_deployment.x.id` purely to create the dependency edge. |
 | `triggers` | map(string) | opt | **RequiresReplace**. Pipelines set `{ run = var.build_id }` to force re-run per build. |
 | `fail_on_test_failure` | bool | opt | default `true`. If true, unmet pass criteria ⇒ apply error ERR_TEST_FAILED (after collection). |
 | **Computed** | | | |
 | `passed` | bool | | pass criteria met |
 | `exit_code` | number | | runner process exit code |
 | `total_tests` / `passed_tests` / `failed_tests` / `skipped_tests` | number | | from TRX/JUnit; -1 when `results.format: none` |
 | `results_dir` | string | | LOCAL dir on runner containing downloaded results+logs |

 Lifecycle: Create runs the tests. Update is never in-place (all arguments are
 RequiresReplace). Delete removes the remote test dir (`best effort`, never fails
 destroy). **Collection always happens before returning a test-failure error** so
 pipelines can publish artifacts from an `always()` step.

 ## 8. Component Contracts
 
 ### 8.1 transport
 
 ```go
 type Shell int // ShellPowerShell, ShellSh, ShellCmd
 type Cmd struct{ Shell Shell; Script string; TimeoutSec int; Env map[string]string }
 type Result struct{ ExitCode int; Stdout, Stderr string }
 
 type Transport interface {
     Connect(ctx context.Context) error
     Close() error
     OS() spec.OSKind
     Host() string
     Exec(ctx context.Context, c Cmd) (Result, error) // err = transport failure ONLY; app exit codes go in Result
     Upload(ctx context.Context, local io.Reader, size int64, remote string) error
     Download(ctx context.Context, remote, local string) error
 }
 ```
 
 Rules:
 - Windows targets: ALL scripts are PowerShell 5.1 (`ShellPowerShell`), executed
   as `powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass
   -EncodedCommand <base64(UTF-16LE(script))>` — identical over WinRM and SSH
   (works from cmd default shell). `Env` is injected by prepending
   `$env:K='V';` lines (single-quote escaped) — never on the command line in
   clear (values may be secrets).
 - Linux targets: `ShellSh` ⇒ `sh -c '<script>'` with env prepended `K='V' `.
 - WinRM upload: chunked base64 append. Chunk = 48,000 raw bytes. First chunk:
   `[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p,[Convert]::FromBase64String($b))`; subsequent:
   open FileStream Append + Write. Progress logged every 5 MB at TRACE.
 - SSH upload/download: SFTP subsystem (`github.com/pkg/sftp`).
 - Local: `os/exec` + file copy; `Connect` verifies OS matches `target.os`.
 - `Connect` retries `target.connect_retries` times, 5s fixed backoff.
   Auth rejection (winrm 401, ssh auth error) is NOT retried ⇒ ERR_AUTH.
   Dial/timeout ⇒ ERR_CONNECT.
 - Preflight (engine, after connect): win ⇒ `$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major`
   must be ≥5; free disk on install_root drive ≥ 2× artifact size (skip when
   size unknown); pattern-specific tool checks (node/npm/dotnet/docker/
   FailoverClusters module) per §6.4 ⇒ failures are ERR_PREFLIGHT.
 
 ### 8.2 artifact
 
 ```go
 type Fetched struct{ LocalPath string; Sha256 string; Size int64 } // runner temp file
 Fetch(ctx, s spec.Artifact, vars Secrets) (Fetched, error)          // http|file|nuget → temp zip
 TargetPullScript(s spec.Artifact) (script string, ok bool)          // §8.3
 ```
 - http/nuget: stream to `os.CreateTemp`, compute sha256 while streaming; compare
   to `artifact.checksum` ⇒ mismatch = ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH (temp deleted).
   4xx/5xx/conn error ⇒ ERR_ARTIFACT_FETCH (include status + first 256B body).
 - docker_image: no fetch on runner; returns ref string; pull happens on target
   inside pattern (§9.6) — bad creds/pull failure ⇒ ERR_ARTIFACT_FETCH.
 
 ### 8.3 target_pull (default for http/nuget sources)
 
 Runner never proxies large payloads. Generated PS (win):
 ```powershell
 $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'
 $h=@{}; if($env:LD_AUTH_VALUE){$h['<auth.header|Authorization>']=$env:LD_AUTH_VALUE}
 Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri '<url>' -Headers $h -OutFile '<staging>\pkg.zip'
 $sha=(Get-FileHash '<staging>\pkg.zip' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
 if($sha -ne '<hex>'){ Write-Error "checksum mismatch: $sha"; exit 41 }
 ```
 `LD_AUTH_VALUE` is passed via Cmd.Env (encoded script, not persisted). Exit 41
 maps to ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH. Linux analog uses curl + `sha256sum`.
 `fetch_mode: runner_push` forces §8.2 + Upload (used when target has no
 egress). file:// sources always runner_push.
 
 ### 8.4 pattern
 
 ```go
 type ReleaseCtx struct{ App, Version string; P Paths; Spec *spec.Deployment; PrevVersion string }
 type Pattern interface {
     Validate(s *spec.Deployment) error                       // static, pattern-specific
     Preflight(ctx, t Transport, rc ReleaseCtx) error
     Configure(ctx, t Transport, rc ReleaseCtx) error         // idempotent: create/update service reg, env, wrapper cfg. Files already switched.
     Stop(ctx, t, rc) error                                   // no-op if absent/stopped
     Start(ctx, t, rc) error                                  // wait until Running/exit ok
     Status(ctx, t, rc) (string, error)                       // §5.2 service_status values
     Uninstall(ctx, t, rc, purge bool) error
 }
 ```
 Engine owns: fetch, staging, extraction, junction switch, files/env rendering,
 health, manifest, prune, lock. Patterns own service/SCM/docker/cluster verbs.
 
 ### 8.5 engine
 
 `Deploy(ctx, s) (*Status, error)`, `Destroy(ctx, s, mode)`, `ReadStatus(ctx, s)`.
 Cluster spec routes to `engine/cluster.go`. All remote steps logged via tflog
 (`step=<NAME> host=<h>`), names exactly: VALIDATE CONNECT PREFLIGHT LOCK FETCH
 CHECKSUM STAGE EXTRACT RENDER CONFIGURE STOP SWITCH START HEALTH FINALIZE PRUNE
 UNLOCK ROLLBACK FORCE_KILL MOVE_GROUP.

 ## 9. Target Layout & Pattern Algorithms
 
 ### 9.1 Layout (identical shape both OSes; `\` ⇢ `/` on linux)
 
 ```
 <install_root>\<app>\
   releases\<version>\        # immutable payload
   current                    # junction/symlink → releases\<version>
   shared\logs\               # survives releases; app should log here (env LD_SHARED_DIR provided)
   staging\                   # downloads/extract temp; wiped at start & end of every op
   manifest.json
   .lock
 ```
 Creation (win): dirs via `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force`.
 Junction switch (win) — EXACT commands:
 ```powershell
 if (Test-Path '<cur>') { cmd /c rmdir '<cur>' ; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit 42} }
 cmd /c mklink /J '<cur>' '<rel>' ; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit 42}
 ```
 (`rmdir` on a junction removes only the link.) Linux: `ln -sfn '<rel>' '<cur>'`.
 Exit 42 ⇒ ERR_SWITCH.
 Extraction (win): `Expand-Archive -Path pkg.zip -DestinationPath '<rel>' -Force`
 (nupkg renamed to .zip first). Linux: `unzip -o` (preflight: unzip present).
 Every release dir gets `.labdeploy-release.json` = `{version, sha256, extracted_at}`.
 
 Provided env to every pattern (merged under spec `environment`, spec wins):
 `LD_APP, LD_VERSION, LD_RELEASE_DIR, LD_SHARED_DIR, PORT (node only)`.
 
 ### 9.2 windows_service — switchover S-steps (normative)
 
 ```
 S0 CONFIG-PRECHECK: sc.exe query "<svc>" → exit 1060 ⇒ not installed (fresh path)
 S1 (update only) STOP:
      Stop-Service -Name <svc> -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      wait Stopped, poll 1s, max stop_timeout_seconds
 S2 (timeout) FORCE_KILL:
      $pid=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -Filter "Name='<svc>'").ProcessId
      if($pid -gt 0){ taskkill /PID $pid /T /F }
      re-wait 10s; still not Stopped ⇒ exit 43 (ERR_SERVICE_STOP)
 S3 SWITCH junction (§9.1)
 S4 CONFIGURE:
    wrapper=none:
      fresh:  sc.exe create "<svc>" binPath= "\"<cur>\<exe>\" <args>" start= <auto|demand|delayed-auto> DisplayName= "<display>"
              (delayed: start= delayed-auto)   obj= "<account>" password= via env-injected variable when non-builtin
      update: sc.exe config "<svc>" binPath= "..."  (binPath uses CURRENT junction ⇒ normally unchanged)
      sc.exe description "<svc>" "<description>"
      recovery: sc.exe failure "<svc>" reset= 86400 actions= restart/5000/restart/5000/restart/5000
    wrapper=winsw:
      write <cur>\<svc>.winsw.xml:
        <service><id><svc></id><name><display></name><executable><abs exe|node_exe></executable>
        <arguments>…</arguments><logpath><shared>\logs</logpath><stopwait><stop_timeout>sec</stopwait>
        <env name=… value=…/>…</service>
      fresh: & '<cur>\<winsw_exe>' install '<cur>\<svc>.winsw.xml'
      update: & … refresh  (fallback: uninstall+install if refresh exit≠0)
 S5 ENV: Set-ItemProperty HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\<svc>
         -Name Environment -Type MultiString -Value @('K=V',…)   # full merged map §9.1
 S6 START: Start-Service <svc>; poll Get-Service status==Running, 1s, max 60s
         not Running ⇒ capture last 20 System-log 7000/7009/7031/7034 events for <svc> into error detail ⇒ exit 44 (ERR_SERVICE_START)
 S7 HEALTH per §6.5 ⇒ fail exit 45 (ERR_HEALTH_CHECK)
 ```
 Fresh install runs S3(create junction) S4 S5 S6 S7 (no S1/S2).

 env) → health(optional). Nothing persistent runs; Stop/Start are no-ops;
 Status = `n/a` if `.labdeploy-release.json` version matches manifest else drift.
 
 ### 9.4 node_web_app / dotnet_api

 (BEFORE switch; exit≠0 ⇒ ERR_SERVICE_INSTALL w/ last 50 lines) → then §9.2 with
 wrapper=winsw and executable=node_exe, arguments=`"<cur>\<entry>"`, env includes
 PORT.
